decision: Use status as a categorical predictor; do not restrict the audit to one listing status.

decision: Retain acre_lot as a core covariate using log1p on observed nonnegative values; use a complete-case analysis rather than median imputation.
audit_evidence: acre_lot is a planned covariate; 14.62% of raw values are missing and 2,226 values are zero, which log1p can represent.

decision: Retain all records: the audit found no exact duplicate rows.
